title: Topics restated in each app
description: Message topic strings published for cross-app communication
body: What this app says to the File Explorer, and what it listens for back. Three strings and two shapes, **restated** in `apps/files/ui/src/topics.ts` rather than shared from one place — the same trade `commands.ts` makes for the menu ids and `rpc.ts` for the backend's reply shapes.
